bio: Alana Kaye came to wine writing by way of theatre, food and books. The Wine Wench grew out of a wish to talk about the people who make wine and the pleasure of drinking it, in language everyone can join in with.

Based in the Southern Highlands of New South Wales, Alana champions Australian producers. A McLaren Vale grenache, Adelaide Hills pinot grigio, Margaret River rosé or Tasmanian sparkling can all find a place at her table. Rosé rarely has to wait for an invitation.
services: Winemaker conversations, tasting features, photography and reels for a winery or food business. Alana especially enjoys telling the stories of small, family-run and sustainability-minded producers. Ask for the current rates card.
A content plan for your own Facebook and Instagram accounts, from the first planning conversation to photography, posting and community management.
Tasting notes for a new vintage, bottle labels, website and search copy, newsletters, customer emails, SMS campaigns, print articles and interviews.
setup: The published packages include community management and the option to run advertising with a separate ad budget. A one-off $399 setup covers a half-day content shoot, editing and a library the client keeps. Custom plans, influencer campaigns, newsletters and blog writing are available by enquiry. Ask Alana to confirm current pricing.
tastings: Planning a Southern Highlands stay? Alana’s at-home tasting concept brings regional wines to your accommodation. The original listing marks the service as coming soon. Send your preferred date and group details to ask about availability and pricing.
series: Thirsty Hungry is Alana’s food-and-wine video series for nights in. Each episode starts with a bottle and something to eat, whether that means cooking dinner or picking up a favourite local takeaway.
